shed_weather_vane.name: Weather vane (cockerel)
shed_weather_vane.flavor: Points with total confidence at wherever the wind isn't.

shed_tyre_swing.name: Tyre swing
shed_tyre_swing.flavor: Built for children, mostly used by adults at barbecues.

shed_bird_bath.name: Bird bath (stone)
shed_bird_bath.flavor: The pigeons treat it as a spa. The robins pay the membership.

shed_garden_gnome.name: Garden gnome (fishing)
shed_garden_gnome.flavor: Has not caught a single fish in eleven years. Remains hopeful.

shed_stone_hare.name: Stone hare
shed_stone_hare.flavor: Sits in the border looking like it has heard something about you.

shed_sundial.name: Sundial on a plinth
shed_sundial.flavor: Accurate to the minute, on the four days a year it gets to work.

shed_obelisk.name: Plant obelisk
shed_obelisk.flavor: Sweet peas are meant to climb it. They have other plans.

shed_trellis_panel.name: Trellis panel
shed_trellis_panel.flavor: Leaning against the shed until the clematis makes up its mind.

shed_water_feature.name: Bubbling water feature
shed_water_feature.flavor: Sold as relaxing. Mainly makes everyone want the loo.

shed_scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
shed_scarecrow.flavor: The crows have known for years. They let him keep his dignity.

shed_windmill.name: Garden windmill
shed_windmill.flavor: Spins happily in a breeze. Panics in anything stronger.

shed_hanging_basket.name: Hanging basket
shed_hanging_basket.flavor: Needs watering twice a day and admiring once.

shed_nest_box.name: Bird nest box
shed_nest_box.flavor: Blue tits viewed it twice and went with the hedge.

shed_insect_hotel.name: Insect hotel
shed_insect_hotel.flavor: Five-star reviews from the solitary bees. Woodlice refuse to leave.

shed_hedgehog_house.name: Hedgehog house
shed_hedgehog_house.flavor: Rent-free, provided the slugs are dealt with.

shed_bee_hive.name: Beehive (National)
shed_bee_hive.flavor: Forty thousand tenants, none of whom have ever paid on time.

shed_cloche.name: Glass bell cloche
shed_cloche.flavor: Keeps one lettuce warm and smug.

shed_cold_frame.name: Cold frame
shed_cold_frame.flavor: A greenhouse for people with modest ambitions and small seedlings.

shed_rain_butt.name: Water butt
shed_rain_butt.flavor: Holds two hundred litres and one small, permanent frog.

shed_leaf_rake.name: Leaf rake
shed_leaf_rake.flavor: Gathers leaves into a pile, then waits for the wind.

shed_loppers.name: Long-handled loppers
shed_loppers.flavor: For branches that have overstayed their welcome.

shed_hedge_trimmer.name: Hedge trimmer
shed_hedge_trimmer.flavor: Makes the hedge look tidy and the neighbours look round.

shed_strimmer.name: Strimmer
shed_strimmer.flavor: Takes the edges off the lawn and the paint off the fence.

shed_leaf_blower.name: Leaf blower
shed_leaf_blower.flavor: Moves leaves from your lawn to next door's with real efficiency.

shed_pump_sprayer.name: Pump sprayer
shed_pump_sprayer.flavor: Five litres of weedkiller and four of regret.

shed_garden_kneeler.name: Garden kneeler
shed_garden_kneeler.flavor: Flip it over and it is a seat. Flip your knees over and they still hurt.

shed_garden_sieve.name: Garden sieve
shed_garden_sieve.flavor: Turns lumpy soil into fine soil and a good arm into a tired one.

shed_trug.name: Garden trug
shed_trug.flavor: Holds a whole morning's weeding and one forgotten trowel.

shed_cane_bundle.name: Bundle of bamboo canes
shed_cane_bundle.flavor: Fifty canes, each with a rubber cap gone missing.

shed_chicken_wire.name: Roll of chicken wire
shed_chicken_wire.flavor: Will scratch you whichever way you hold it.

shed_sprinkler.name: Oscillating sprinkler
shed_sprinkler.flavor: Waters the lawn evenly, and the person who set it up thoroughly.

shed_lawn_spreader.name: Lawn feed spreader
shed_lawn_spreader.flavor: Perfectly even, apart from the stripes everyone can see.

shed_garden_roller.name: Garden roller
shed_garden_roller.flavor: Flattens the lawn and anyone who tries to lift it.

shed_compost_sack.name: Sack of compost
shed_compost_sack.flavor: Seventy litres. Somehow always split at the bottom corner.

shed_incinerator.name: Garden incinerator
shed_incinerator.flavor: Burns the hedge clippings and, briefly, the neighbours' goodwill.

shed_pressure_washer.name: Pressure washer
shed_pressure_washer.flavor: Reveals the patio's true colour, and some of next door's.

shed_rotary_line.name: Rotary washing line (folded)
shed_rotary_line.flavor: Spins in the wind like it is trying to take off.

shed_workbench.name: Workbench
shed_workbench.flavor: Nobody has seen the actual surface since 2009.

shed_bench_vice.name: Bench vice
shed_bench_vice.flavor: Holds anything firmly except the attention of whoever's using it.

shed_bench_grinder.name: Bench grinder
shed_bench_grinder.flavor: Puts an edge on anything, including your nerves.

shed_pillar_drill.name: Bench pillar drill
shed_pillar_drill.flavor: Drills a perfectly straight hole slightly to the left of the mark.

shed_mitre_saw.name: Mitre saw
shed_mitre_saw.flavor: Forty-five degrees on the dial, forty-three on the skirting.

shed_drill_case.name: Cordless drill in its case
shed_drill_case.flavor: Battery always flat. Spare battery always flatter.

shed_wood_plane.name: Woodworking plane
shed_wood_plane.flavor: Grandad's. Sharper than anything else in the house.

shed_sash_clamps.name: Sash clamps (pair)
shed_sash_clamps.flavor: For holding two bits of wood together while the glue argues.

shed_screw_drawers.name: Screw and nail drawers
shed_screw_drawers.flavor: Sixty little drawers. The screw you need is in the sixty-first.

shed_anvil.name: Small anvil
shed_anvil.flavor: Bought for a hobby that lasted a weekend. Will outlive the house.

shed_chopping_block.name: Log chopping block
shed_chopping_block.flavor: A stump with a scar for every winter.

shed_log_store.name: Log store
shed_log_store.flavor: Stacked with the dry logs at the back, where nobody can reach them.

shed_workshop_vac.name: Wet and dry vac
shed_workshop_vac.flavor: Hoovers up sawdust, water and, once, a hamster. He was fine.

shed_air_compressor.name: Air compressor
shed_air_compressor.flavor: Inflates a football in two seconds and wakes the street doing it.

shed_extension_reel.name: Extension cable reel
shed_extension_reel.flavor: Twenty-five metres, used to reach the plug two feet away.

shed_jerry_can.name: Jerry can
shed_jerry_can.flavor: Twenty litres, for the mower that only needs one.

shed_trolley_jack.name: Trolley jack
shed_trolley_jack.flavor: Lifts a car with ease, provided you can remember where it goes.

shed_car_ramps.name: Car ramps (pair)
shed_car_ramps.flavor: Driven up once, very slowly, with someone shouting.

shed_sack_truck.name: Sack truck
shed_sack_truck.flavor: The only member of the household who enjoys moving day.

shed_bike_pump.name: Track bike pump
shed_bike_pump.flavor: Brings every tyre to the right pressure except the one that's flat.

shed_bike_stand.name: Bike repair stand
shed_bike_stand.flavor: Holds the bike at a perfect height for not fixing it.

shed_chiminea.name: Chiminea
shed_chiminea.flavor: Smokes like a chimney, mainly in the direction of the guests.

shed_fire_pit.name: Fire pit bowl
shed_fire_pit.flavor: Everyone gathers round it, then moves every time the smoke does.

shed_folding_table.name: Folding garden table
shed_folding_table.flavor: Seats four, wobbles for all of them.

shed_swing_seat.name: Garden swing seat
shed_swing_seat.flavor: A three-seater, in theory. A one-and-a-half-seater with a cat.

shed_croquet_set.name: Croquet set in a stand
shed_croquet_set.flavor: Garden croquet. Friendships end on the second hoop.

shed_swingball.name: Swingball
shed_swingball.flavor: Seventeen minutes of fun, then a ball wrapped tight round the top.

shed_goal_net.name: Pop-up football goal
shed_goal_net.flavor: Last used as an excuse for the broken greenhouse pane.

shed_sledge.name: Wooden sledge
shed_sledge.flavor: Waits patiently all year for the one Tuesday of snow.

shed_rabbit_hutch.name: Rabbit hutch
shed_rabbit_hutch.flavor: Two storeys, a run and a view. Better than most London flats.

shed_kennel.name: Dog kennel
shed_kennel.flavor: Built for the dog. The dog sleeps on the sofa.

shed_garden_gate.name: Spare garden gate
shed_garden_gate.flavor: Off its hinges since the storm. Still squeaks out of habit.

shed_mangle.name: Old mangle
shed_mangle.flavor: Squeezes the water out of sheets and the joy out of Mondays.

shed_tool_rack.name: Long-handled tool rack
shed_tool_rack.flavor: Every tool has its hook. Every hook has someone else's tool.

shed_potting_bench.name: Potting bench
shed_potting_bench.flavor: Where seedlings start life and teacups end it.

shed_propagator.name: Heated propagator
shed_propagator.flavor: Tomatoes from seed by May, or a tray of green fluff.

shed_bird_seed_bin.name: Bird seed bin
shed_bird_seed_bin.flavor: Locked against squirrels. They have the code.
